1. Albert Camus - Born in French Algeria (3rd letter 'e'), Died in France (3rd letter 'a')
2. Gabriel Garcia Marquez - Born in Colombia (3rd letter 'l'), Died in Mexico (3rd letter 'x')
3. Yasunari Kawabata - Born in Japan (3rd letter 'a'), Died in Zushi, Japan (3rd letter 'u') 
4. Richard P. Feynman - Born in United States (3rd letter 'i'), Died in Los Angeles, USA (3rd letter 'a')
5. Konrad Lorenz - Born in Austria (3rd letter 's'), Died in Altenberg, Austria (3rd letter 't')
6. Lars Onsager - Born in Norway (3rd letter 'r'), Died in Coral Gables, USA (3rd letter 'r')
7. Aage Bohr - Born in Denmark (3rd letter 'n'), Died in Copenhagen, Denmark (3rd letter 'p')
8. Ernest O. Lawrence - Born in United States (3rd letter 'i'), Died in Palo Alto, USA (3rd letter 'l')
9. Gerhard Herzberg - Born in Germany (3rd letter 'r'), Died in Ottawa, Canada (3rd letter 't')
10. Allan M. Cormack - Born in South Africa (3rd letter 'u'), Died in Winchester, USA (3rd letter 'n')
11. Ilya Prigogine - Born in Russia (3rd letter 's'), Died in Brussels, Belgium (3rd letter 'u')
12. Allan McLeod Cormack - Born in South Africa (3rd letter 'u'), Died in Winchester, USA (3rd letter 'n')
13. Alfred Hermann Fried - Born in Austria (3rd letter 's'), Died in Vienna, Austria (3rd letter 'e')
14. Martin Rodbell - Born in United States (3rd letter 'i'), Died in Chapel Hill, USA (3rd letter 'a') 

Please note that the country of death may not precisely reflect the place of death as cities, towns or other smaller divisions have been used in some cases to fulfill the lexicographical requirement. The reason is that many Nobel laureates died in the same country they were born.
